verdict.rationale: Wise documents a first-party Webhook API for subscribing to events at both the application and profile level. It supports creating, listing, retrieving and deleting subscriptions, plus testing webhook endpoints, so the core of the story is delivered. However, the evidence is a single reference-page summary. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, payload signature verification and retry/delivery details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Manage webhook subscriptions at both the application and profile level. Create, list, retrieve, and delete subscriptions, as well as test your webhook endpoints.
